run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T15:31:41Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is firing because frontend-proxy ingress spans began returning HTTP 500 as propagation of a checkout-path failure. frontend-proxy ingress ERROR spans were 0-6/min through 15:31:00, then 18 at 15:32:00 and 52-70/min afterwards, while total ingress spans stayed flat at ~1206-1520/min; frontend-proxy's own log shows "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream with upstream cluster frontend while other routes return 200. A whole failing trace shows load-generator -> frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress -> frontend POST /api/checkout -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (gRPC 13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (13) -> checkout HTTP POST -> shipping /get-quote ("Internal Server Error", 5.001705s) -> shipping client span "POST quote" ("Timeout", 5.001645s), with no downstream quote span in that trace. checkout and frontend carry the exact text "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500". The quote service answers fast when it answers (all completed POST /getquote spans fall in histogram buckets <=10ms) but its inbound span count collapses from 62-98/min before 15:31 to 10-16/min from 15:32 onward, and email's per-checkout count falls in lockstep. Chaos Mesh PodNetworkChaos events (chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1) for pods quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv begin at 2026-11-16T15:31:35Z and repeat about once a minute through 15:40:35Z, six seconds before the alert fired and one minute before the error step change. All pods are Running with restartCount 0 and were created 14:54:5x; nodes are Ready without pressure; quote and email Service selectors and Endpoints are correct. The supported explanation is an injected network fault on the quote pod (with a matching fault on the shipping pod) preventing most shipping-to-quote POSTs from completing, so shipping hits its ~5s deadline and returns 500, which checkout, frontend and frontend-proxy relay to the load generator. The email service shows no failure evidence of its own, and no email span appears in the failing trace.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans exist only for span_name "ingress" and "router frontend egress", with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR; the service's status_code label values are only STATUS_CODE_ERROR and STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Per-minute frontend-proxy ingress ERROR spans were 0-6/min from 15:21:00 through 15:31:00 (2 at 15:31:00), then 18 at 15:32:00, 54 at 15:33:00, 70 at 15:34:00 and 52-70/min afterwards: a step change at 15:32:00.
frontend-proxy ingress spans without an error status stayed at 1206-1520 per minute over 15:21-15:44 while the ERROR series rose, so the increase is not a traffic surge.
In failing traces the frontend-proxy spans "ingress" and "router frontend egress" carry http.status_code=500 and error=true, matching the alert's error-rate signal for frontend-proxy.

frontend-proxy's container log shows "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream with upstream cluster frontend, while /api/cart, /api/products and /api/recommendations return 200, so the proxy relays an upstream 500 rather than failing locally.

Failing trace 925ee26147ff69ef34318fad699a2701 shows load-generator POST -> frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress -> frontend POST /api/checkout -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (13) -> checkout prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart -> checkout HTTP POST -> shipping /get-quote (error, "Internal Server Error", 5.001705s) -> shipping "POST quote" (error, "Timeout", 5.001645s); no quote-service span appears in that trace.

The propagated error text is exact and repeated: checkout's otel.status_description and frontend's exception.message read "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500", with frontend's grpc.error_message prefixing "13 INTERNAL: ".

Error spans in the checkout path are confined to checkout "oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" and "HTTP POST", shipping "/get-quote" and "POST quote", and frontend "POST /api/checkout", "POST", "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"; payment error series read 0 and cart/currency/product-catalog returned no error series in that breakdown.

Every completed quote-service span for operation "POST /getquote" lies in duration histogram buckets at or below 10ms (the le="10.0" bucket value equals le="+Inf" in every window sampled), so the quote process answers quickly when it answers.

quote's per-minute "POST /getquote" span count fell from 62-98/min through 15:31:00 to 12 at 15:32:00 and 10-16/min afterwards, and email's "POST /send_order_confirmation" count fell in lockstep from 98 at 15:31:00 to 12 at 15:32:00.

quote's process log emits only sparse "Calculated quote" lines during the incident (324 lines captured between 15:25 and 15:41) while shipping logs "Requesting quote" many times per minute, consistent with most quote requests not being served.

Chaos Mesh events begin at 2026-11-16T15:31:35Z in namespace otel-demo: kind PodNetworkChaos (apiVersion chaos-mesh.org/v1alpha1), source component podnetworkchaos, annotations chaos-mesh.org/type=updated, message "Successfully update ObservedGeneration and FailedMessage of resource", involvedObject names quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, repeating roughly every minute through 15:40:35Z.
All 38 events returned in otel-demo are PodNetworkChaos events and they involve only the quote pod and the shipping pod.

No pod restart, crash or rollout explains the incident: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running, ready, with restartCount 0, empty lastState and no waiting reason, created 2026-11-16T14:54:52-54Z (before the incident).
All five cluster nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False and 4 allocatable CPUs each, so node pressure is not evident.

Deployment configuration identifies the failing target: shipping has env QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, quote runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-quote with limits cpu 5m / memory 40Mi, and email runs 2.1.3-email with limits cpu 50m / memory 100Mi.

Service wiring is correct at query time: Service quote selects opentelemetry.io/name=quote and Service email selects opentelemetry.io/name=email (both port 8080), and Endpoints are populated for both (quote 100.96.1.165 on node i-0b4b26fa385533a10, email 100.96.2.193).

CPU starvation is not supported for the failing hop: quote, email and shipping CFS throttled-period ratios were 3.8-8.2% across the window with no step at 15:32, and quote CPU usage stayed near 0.0003-0.0013 cores against its 5m limit.

The email service shows no failure signal of its own: its only spans "POST /send_order_confirmation", "send_email" and "sinatra.render_template" carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET, the per-service error query returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series for service_name=email, its CPU usage was ~0.0009-0.004 cores, and no email span appears in the failing trace.

Small unrelated error counts appear for ad (1.04-2.07 per window), fraud-detection (1.04-2.07) and recommendation (1.03-2.07), far below the checkout-path error increases (checkout 281-765, frontend 538-1554, frontend-proxy 284-790, shipping 283-770 per window), so those series are not the driver of this alert.

Pod restart, OOMKill or controller rollout is rejected as the cause: every pod is Running with restartCount 0 and created at 14:54:5x with no later replacement, and the only in-window events are PodNetworkChaos updates.

A Service selector or Endpoint misconfiguration between shipping and quote is rejected: the quote Service selector matches the quote pod and its Endpoints subset contains quote pod IP 100.96.1.165 on port 8080, and email's Endpoints are likewise populated.

Most likely cause: a chaos-mesh network fault injected on the quote pod (with a matching PodNetworkChaos on the shipping pod) prevents most shipping-to-quote POSTs from reaching or completing at quote — quote's inbound span count drops sharply at 15:32:00 while total user traffic is flat, shipping's client span then exhausts its ~5s deadline, and the 500 propagates shipping -> checkout -> frontend -> frontend-proxy ingress. The chaos events appear at 15:31:35Z, 6s before the alert fired and one minute before the error step change.

A second, unresolved candidate is that the chaos on the shipping pod (not only on quote) blocks the outbound POST; both pods carry PodNetworkChaos events from 15:31:35Z, so the direction of the injected fault cannot be separated with the available evidence, only that traffic between them stopped completing.

The "failed POST to email service" wording is not corroborated by email-side telemetry: no email span is present in the failing trace, email spans record no error status, and shipping's only configured outbound target is QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, so the string may be a templated or mislabeled message rather than evidence that email failed.

Inspect the generated chaos objects (NetworkChaos/PodNetworkChaos in namespace otel-demo for quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv) to confirm the injected action (loss/delay/partition), duration and selectivity, then remove or let the fault expire and watch frontend-proxy ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR and quote "POST /getquote" throughput recover.

gaps: The PodNetworkChaos/NetworkChaos custom resources and their specs could not be read: only the event kind was available, so the fault action (packet loss vs delay vs partition), its percentage, direction and intended end time are unknown.

The trace search for email spans tagged error=true in 15:30-15:49 returned no data (status no_data), so absence of email error traces is not established; only email's span statuses and its missing ERROR series were observed.

kube-state-metrics series such as kube_deployment_status_replicas_available returned no data for quote/shipping/email/frontend-proxy, so deployment replica availability during the window could not be verified from Prometheus.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in the loaded rule set (list_prometheus_rules for alertname=RequestErrorRate returned no data), so its exact expression and threshold were not verified; the annotation value 0.6444 is treated as unverified alert data.

The email container produced no stdout lines in the window (its log read returned no data), and the frontend-proxy and shipping log reads were sampled to the newest lines, so log-side evidence for those services is partial.
No change-history integration is available, so whether the chaos objects were introduced by a scheduled experiment or a manual action is unknown.
Whether the network chaos is still active is unknown: the last PodNetworkChaos event is 15:40:35Z while frontend-proxy errors continued at 52-70/min through the last available sample (~15:44:00).
Why the propagated error text names an "email service" while shipping's configured POST target is quote remains unexplained by any span or log evidence.
next_steps: List and read the NetworkChaos/PodNetworkChaos objects referenced by the 15:31:35Z events in namespace otel-demo to confirm the injected action, selector and duration.
Re-check frontend-proxy ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR per minute and quote "POST /getquote" throughput after 15:49 to confirm recovery to the pre-15:31 baseline.
Independently verify connectivity and the ~5s client deadline between the shipping and quote pods (e.g. a probe from the shipping pod) so the timeout budget can be assessed.
Verify shipping's outbound target in its source/config to explain why its error message references an "email service" when QUOTE_ADDR points at http://quote:8080.
